title: Tri-party collateral management from BNP Paribas Securities Services
description: Discover how BNP Paribas' tri-party collateral management service helps connect market players worldwide, ensuring seamless integration of their operations and providing solutions to asset segregation  English For more, visit our corporate site and list of products http://securities.bnpparibas.com/  Join us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/bnpparibassecuritiesservices  Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/BNPP2S

asr.full_text: I'm an institutional investor. I need a solid post trade collateral management solution. As an investment bank I have been coping with collateral requirements for awhile I need expertise on repo securities lending and derivatives i must find new counterparties and sources of revenue I want to capitalize on emerging opportunities. We are world leading custodian, we simplify collateral Our solution goes beyond collateral, from our agency lending program to middle and back office services. Seems fine, but what about inventory management? This is an operational nightmare. Our tri-party service can be connected directly to your trading account, with a simple addendum to our legal framework. No need to manage a long box anymore. Hang on. I need to move assets back and forth between local markets and Longbox accounts, resulting in significant costs. Can you help? Well, yes, of course. We are both a local and global custodian. We can help you source collateral directly from our own local custody franchise. As a portfolio manager, I need a guarantee that regulatory segregation is respected. Otherwise this may prevent further business development. I am facing strong limitations as well. I can't easily source niche liquidity on segregated and frontier markets. Our tri-party service complies with segregation requirements stemming from regulation, market practice, or risk policies. We help you access liquidity pools wherever they are. Based on our twenty years of experience in security services, we designed a streamlined and competitive solution to support you in a changing world. Our tri-party service reduces collateral risks, costs and burden and helps you to expand your business.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents BNP Paribas Securities Services' tri-party collateral-management product for institutional investors, investment banks, and portfolio managers. It describes operational services such as collateral sourcing, regulatory segregation, and liquidity access rather than directing a general audience to transfer money or provide private credentials. References to revenue opportunities, liquidity, and business expansion are framed as service capabilities and business objectives, and the closing branding supports the corporate-promotion context.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is ordinary commercial promotion of a financial-services product involving tri-party collateral management, custody, asset segregation, and liquidity access. The supplied evidence does not show a gift-card flow, task-based income, credential request, recruitment structure, or a specific investment-return solicitation.
